brands.name: PrepayPower
brands.description: Ireland's leading pay-as-you-go energy supplier serving ~180,000 households. Offers prepaid electricity, gas, dual fuel, and broadband — no traditional bills. Customers top up via app, website, or Payzone outlets nationwide.
targetCustomers: Irish households seeking budget control over energy spend
Renters and people who prefer pay-as-you-go over monthly bills
Property professionals: landlords, letting agents, Approved Housing Bodies, Local Authorities, PRS developments
products: Prepaid Electricity (Classic Pay & Smart Pay meters)
PrepayBroadband (unlimited, charges daily to electricity meter)
Property Professionals (landlord portal, bulk smart metering for rental properties)

keyTerms.PowerCode: Unique top-up code used to add credit to an electricity meter
keyTerms.Classic Pay Meter: Traditional prepaid electricity meter requiring manual PowerCode entry
keyTerms.Smart Pay Meter: Smart prepaid electricity meter with app integration and hourly usage updates
keyTerms.Payzone: Nationwide network of retail outlets where customers can top up with cash
keyTerms.PSO Levy: Public Service Obligation levy — government charge on all Irish electricity accounts (currently €19.10/account) funding renewables and indigenous fuels
keyTerms.Prepayment Service Charge: Daily charge (currently 45.04c/day) to maintain the PAYG infrastructure
keyTerms.Standing Charge: Fixed daily charge regardless of usage; varies by meter type and urban/rural tariff
keyTerms.Unit Rate: Price per kWh of electricity or gas consumed
keyTerms.NightSaver: Electricity tariff with cheaper off-peak night rates for customers with a NightSaver meter
keyTerms.Emergency Credit: Short-term credit auto-activated when balance hits zero to prevent power loss
keyTerms.Friendly Credit: Out-of-hours credit ensuring customers are not cut off during evenings/weekends
keyTerms.GPRN: Gas Point Reference Number — unique identifier for a gas connection, required for gas switching
keyTerms.Eircode: Irish postcode used when setting up broadband service
keyTerms.Dual Fuel: Combined electricity and gas supply under a single account
keyTerms.ESB Energisation: Process of connecting a new property to the ESB electricity network, tracked from construction stage

keyProcesses: Customer switching (electricity, gas, broadband) — PrepayPower manages changeover with previous supplier
Meter installation — Smart Pay or Classic Pay meter fitted at customer premises
Top-up — via PrepayPower app, website (/topping/top-now), or Payzone retail network
Moving home — customer registers new address, meter type determined at new property
Referral — existing customer refers friend, both receive bonus credit after successful meter installation
Property professional onboarding — landlord portal setup, bulk meter management, ESG reporting

brands.name: Yuno Energy
brands.description: Ireland's newest billpay electricity and gas provider. Digital-first, app-managed energy with competitive fixed and variable tariffs. No prepay — all plans are traditional billpay with a 12-month initial period. Paperless billing. Supports microgeneration (solar export tariff).
targetCustomers: Irish households preferring monthly billing over pay-as-you-go
Tech-comfortable customers who want app-based energy management
Price-conscious switchers looking for competitive fixed rates
products: Yuno Fixed — fixed-rate electricity plan, cheapest option for new customers
Yuno Variable Discount Plan — variable rate with discount applied
Yuno Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan — time-of-use tariff for smart meter customers (cheaper off-peak rates)
Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan — combined electricity + gas, paperless, requires Yuno app
Gas Supply — standard variable gas tariff

keyTerms.Yuno App: Mobile app (required for some plans) for usage tracking, bill management, payments and top-ups
keyTerms.Fixed Plan: Electricity plan with a locked unit rate for the contract term — protects against price rises
keyTerms.Variable Plan: Electricity or gas plan where the unit rate can change with market conditions
keyTerms.Day/Night/Peak (Smart TOU): Time-of-use tariff splitting usage into day, night and peak rates — cheaper at off-peak times; requires a smart meter
keyTerms.Dual Fuel: Combined electricity and gas supply under a single Yuno Energy account
keyTerms.Microgeneration / Clean Export Tariff: Payment to customers who export unused solar-generated electricity back to the grid (currently 15.89c/kWh, rising to 17.16c/kWh from July 2026)
keyTerms.EAB (Estimated Annual Bill): Standardised estimate based on CRU typical annual consumption figures, used for plan comparison
keyTerms.Carbon Tax: Government levy on gas consumption (currently €0.0125 incl. VAT per kWh); same rate across all Irish suppliers
keyTerms.Unit Rate: Price per kWh of electricity or gas consumed
keyTerms.Standing Charge: Fixed daily charge applied regardless of usage
keyTerms.PSO Levy: Public Service Obligation levy applied to all Irish electricity accounts to fund renewables
keyTerms.Smart Meter: Advanced electricity meter enabling time-of-use tariffs and real-time consumption data; required for Day/Night/Peak plan
keyTerms.Paperless Billing: Bills delivered digitally via app/email — required for Smart Dual Fuel Plan
keyTerms.CRU: Commission for Regulation of Utilities — Irish energy regulator; sets standard consumption figures used in EAB calculations

keyProcesses: Customer switching — Yuno Energy handles changeover from previous electricity/gas supplier
Plan sign-up — online or via app; 12-month initial period with termination fee if exiting early
Smart meter onboarding — customer requests smart meter from ESB Networks, then upgrades to Day/Night/Peak plan
Microgeneration registration — customer registers solar/generation system to receive clean export tariff payments
Direct debit billing — monthly bill generated from meter reads; paid by direct debit
App-based account management — usage, bills, payments and plan changes via Yuno app

brands.name: Yuno Energy Heat
brands.description: Renewable heating solutions including heat pumps and home heating services for Irish homes
targetCustomers: Irish homeowners seeking renewable heating alternatives

brands.name: Firmus
brands.description: Natural gas distribution and supply network in Northern Ireland
targetCustomers: Households and businesses in Northern Ireland

crossBrandTerms.CRN: Customer Reference Number — primary key for all customer records across all brands
crossBrandTerms.MPRN: Meter Point Reference Number — unique ID for an electricity meter connection point
crossBrandTerms.GPRN: Gas Point Reference Number — unique ID for a gas connection point
crossBrandTerms.MM (Market Message): Automated messages exchanged with ESB Networks or GNI, e.g. MM110 (debt), MM011 (COT), G206N (gas), G201RQ (gas read request)
crossBrandTerms.COT: Change of Tenancy — process when a new tenant takes over a property, or Change of Tariff
crossBrandTerms.POA: Power of Attorney — customer account authority request
crossBrandTerms.DPA: Data Protection Act — compliance context for breach notifications and data handling
crossBrandTerms.SAR: Subject Access Request — customer data request under GDPR
crossBrandTerms.VC: Vulnerable Customer — customers on a protected list requiring special handling
crossBrandTerms.L1E: Low Income Electricity — customers processed via Liberty for vends/advance credit (MABs, NGOs)
crossBrandTerms.NPS: Net Promoter Score — customer satisfaction survey sent after interactions
crossBrandTerms.IVR: Interactive Voice Response — automated phone menu system built in 8x8
crossBrandTerms.DND: Do Not Disconnect — list of accounts exempted from disconnection during a period
crossBrandTerms.RREL: Meter read status code for a large estimated read — triggers proactive billing comms
crossBrandTerms.SVOD: State/Volume of Day — end-of-day CX reporting format
crossBrandTerms.MABs: Money Advice and Budgeting Service — NGO that requests vends/advance credit for low-income customers
crossBrandTerms.RAF: Refer a Friend — referral scheme across PPP and Yuno Energy
crossBrandTerms.Pipeline: Dev → Test → Prod deployment process for Power Automate solutions
crossBrandTerms.EV Tariff: Electric Vehicle energy tariff — time-of-use rate for EV owners

internalSystems.name: 8x8
internalSystems.description: Cloud contact centre platform for voice, email, SMS, chat, IVR and agent workspace. Used across PPP, Yuno, and Firmus tenants. Migrated from In2tel.

internalSystems.name: Cognigy
internalSystems.description: Agent-assist chat bot platform. PPP Bot and Yuno Bot handle agent requests — HappyFox tickets, meter changes, vend requests, etc.

internalSystems.name: Max Power
internalSystems.description: Main CRM/customer management system for PPP and Yuno accounts, meter status, call dispositions and dropdowns.

internalSystems.name: Liberty
internalSystems.description: Account management system for L1E (low-income electricity) customers. Used for vend processing via RPA.

internalSystems.name: Genio
internalSystems.description: Pricing and usage check system for PrepayPower.

internalSystems.name: HappyFox
internalSystems.description: Helpdesk ticketing system. Agents create/update tickets via the bot or PA flows. Queues managed by Desktop Support.

internalSystems.name: SharePoint
internalSystems.description: Primary data store for almost all DT processes — lists for meter changes, vulnerable customers, COT, POA, market messaging, retention, etc.

internalSystems.name: Power BI
internalSystems.description: Reporting and dashboards — NPS, IVR calls, COP dashboard, retention, VC audit.

internalSystems.name: SQL Server (ppp-prod-sqlr01)
internalSystems.description: Main reports/BI database. Key tables: PPPGas.dbo.PPPMarketMessages, Yuno Reporting, RAF URLs.

internalSystems.name: Knack
internalSystems.description: Third-party platform used by Broadband Retention for tracking customer call statuses.

internalSystems.name: ESB Networks (ESBN)
internalSystems.description: Irish electricity distribution network. Sends/receives market messages (MM110, MM011, etc.) that trigger PA flows.

internalSystems.name: GNI (Gas Networks Ireland)
internalSystems.description: Irish gas distribution network. Sends market messages (G206N, G201RQ) processed by PA flows.

internalSystems.name: Enet
internalSystems.description: Broadband infrastructure provider. Sends outage alerts and invoices; de-energised accounts with active BB are tracked against Enet charges.

internalSystems.name: Zapier
internalSystems.description: Legacy automation platform — flows being migrated to Power Automate.

internalSystems.name: Shelf
internalSystems.description: Knowledge base platform used by CX agents. DT team documents flows and processes there.

internalSystems.name: Creovai
internalSystems.description: Agent Assist AI tool (in trial) for real-time call guidance.

team.name: Digital Transformation (DT) Team
team.specialisation: Full generalists — all three members build PA flows, configure 8x8, develop Copilot Studio bots, and handle BI/reporting. No domain specialisation.
team.taskTracking: Asana — each flow/feature maps to an Asana task in the Digital Transformation Tasklist project

sections.Backlog: Not yet started — all incoming requests land here
sections.Current Sprint: Queued and ready to pick up
sections.Doing: Actively being built — PA flows in Dev environment
sections.Updates: Minor changes / tweaks to already-live flows (not new builds)

environments.Test - DTA: UAT / staging — business sign-off before go-live
environments.Prepay Power (default): Legacy PPP production environment — some older solutions live here

team.deploymentPipeline: Power Platform Admin Centre (PPAC) built-in pipeline — Dev → Test → Prod. NOT using manual pac CLI export/import per environment.
team.documentationStandard: Every solution gets a FLOWS.md auto-generated by the toolkit, shared to SharePoint for team visibility.

internalAgentBots.note: IMPORTANT: All Asana tasks referencing 'the BOT' or 'bot' mean Microsoft Copilot Studio on Teams — NOT Cognigy, NOT a third-party chatbot platform.
internalAgentBots.connectionToPowerAutomate: Native 'Run a flow' action inside Copilot Studio topics — tightly coupled in the same Power Platform environment. Bot solutions export includes both Copilot Studio topic definitions AND the PA flows called from topics.
botSolutions: PPP CX Support Bot — agent-facing bot for PrepayPower CX team
Yuno CX Support Bot — agent-facing bot for Yuno Energy CX team
BOT Retention Ops — Retention team agent bot
Project Guide Bot — internal DT team bot
commonTopics: NPS capture at end of topic

customerFacingWhatsApp.outbound: PA flows call the Liveperson REST API to send WhatsApp templates (retention comms, T&Cs acceptance, RAF links, appointment confirmations, meter read requests)
customerFacingWhatsApp.inbound: When customers reply on WhatsApp, Liveperson sends webhooks to PA HTTP-triggered flows for processing the response
customerFacingWhatsApp.note: Liveperson handles both PPP and Yuno Energy WhatsApp channels. All WhatsApp template sends go via Liveperson REST API — not directly via a WhatsApp Business API.

customerFacingChat.description: Customer-facing live chat widget on PrepayPower and Yuno Energy websites. Separate from the Teams agent bots.

cognigy.note: Cognigy is barely used — only briefly explored for a Yuno customer-facing bot. It is NOT the main bot platform. Do not assume Cognigy when tasks mention 'bot'.

flowConventions.solutionNaming: Brand prefix + descriptive name. E.g. PPP_MarketMessaging, YE_CustomerSwitching, FIR_GasAlerts
flowConventions.flowNaming: Verb + subject + trigger type. E.g. 'Process MM110 Debt Alert', 'Send NPS Survey on Case Close', 'Sync VC List Nightly'
triggerTypes: SharePoint list item created/modified — most CX workflows
HTTP request — triggered by Cognigy bot or external system
ESBN/GNI market message received — market messaging flows
flowConventions.errorHandling: All flows use a top-level try/catch scope. Failures post to a SharePoint error log list and send a Teams alert to the DT channel.
connectors: SharePoint — primary data store for lists and files
SQL Server (ppp-prod-sqlr01) — reporting queries and BI data
HTTP — 8x8 REST API, HappyFox API, external webhooks
Outlook / Teams — internal notifications and approvals

process: 1. Asana task created — describes the requirement, linked to a brand and system
2. Flow designed and built in Dev environment
3. FLOWS.md generated and shared to SharePoint
4. Tested with real or mock data in Test environment
5. Business sign-off from relevant team lead
7. Asana task marked complete with solution name in comments
